subject: Urgent: hotpatch SLA, triage playbook & evidence request
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@acmetech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: hotpatch SLA, triage playbook & evidence request

Grace —

Thanks for the quick onboarding so far. Security is escalating a hard deadline: our internal compliance requires a VM evidence bundle for the upcoming SIG review and the CAIQ mapping. We need the following within 48 hours if possible:

- Scan export for May 30 – Jun 1 (CSV) with vulnerability IDs, CVSS, ownership, and status.
- A short attestation that Redwood will meet the hotpatch SLA for Critical CVEs (we need explicit hours for hosted vs dedicated).
- Excerpt of your triage/playbook showing emergency patch windows and rollback procedures.
- Patch notes or confirmation for CVE-2025-1101 (affects one of our integrations).

This is a gating item for our SIG submission (deadline next week). If you can’t meet 48 hours, propose the fastest partial deliverable timeline (e.g., scan export + attestation first, playbook after). Also let us know if any of this requires an NDA/DocuSign attestation.

Appreciate a direct phone number if we need to escalate.

—Samir Rao
Security Operations
AcmeTech
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@acmetech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: hotpatch SLA, triage playbook & evidence request

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the clear list. We can assemble an evidence packet. Proposed plan (short timeline):

1) Within 24 hours: scan export (CSV) + provisional attestation summary (SLA hours, scope) + CVE-2025-1101 patch note stub.
2) Within 72 hours: full SIG/CAIQ section for VM, playbook excerpt (redacted where necessary), and formal signed attestation (DocuSign link if required).
3) If you need a live walkthrough, we can schedule a 30-min call today or tomorrow — Kimberly (cc) will lead technical details; Marissa will handle evidence packaging for SOC 2 / CAIQ fields.

We will attach: scan-export-20250601.csv, acmetech-sig-vm-playbook-excerpt.pdf, and a draft SOC 2 attestation letter. Some internal logs will need redaction for third-party distribution; we will mark any redacted fields and provide a provenance statement.

Is 24 / 72 workable or do you need everything sooner?

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Lena Ortiz <devops@acmetech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@acmetech.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: hotpatch SLA, triage playbook & evidence request

Grace / team —

Appreciate the quick response. A couple of clarifications before you send the packet:

- Please include the patch notes and test checklist for CVE-2025-1101; we need to confirm the CVE is fixed in the v2.3 runtime and backported to the dedicated pools.
- We require explicit rollback/rollback-window procedures (example steps and owner contacts) for emergency hotpatches.
- For SLA: security wants a guaranteed operational window (we prefer 24 hours for Critical for production tenants). If Redwood provides 48 hours for hosted but 24 for Dedicated, please specify in the attestation.
- DocuSign: yes — we can sign a short attestation letter. Please send the link when the attestation draft is ready.

We are preparing our SIG submission and will flag any gaps — target acceptance depends on the completeness of the VM section.

Thanks — Lena
Head of DevOps
AcmeTech
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@acmetech.com>, Lena Ortiz <devops@acmetech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: hotpatch SLA, triage playbook & evidence request

Hi Samir / Lena —

Attached: acmetech-sig-vm-playbook-excerpt.pdf, scan-export-20250601.csv, cve-2025-1101-patch-notes.txt, redwood-soc2-vm-attestation-letter.pdf

Executive summary (attestation):
- Scope: This attestation covers Redwood Inference hosted API and Dedicated GPU pools used by AcmeTech under current ordering documents.
- SLA for Critical vulnerabilities (CVSS >= 9.0): Redwood Inference commits to a maximum remediation/mitigation window of 48 hours for Hosted customers and 24 hours for Dedicated customers where customers have permitted emergency maintenance windows and provided access for hotpatch deployment. For managed integrations where a third-party vendor is required, timelines are best-effort and will be documented per-case.
- Triage/playbook: The attached excerpt shows our emergency triage stages, owner handoffs, escalation matrix (PagerOps -> Infra -> Security), and rollback checklist. The rollback procedure includes an automated snapshot rollback for dedicated pools and a tested fallback model for hosted slices; contact points are listed in the excerpt.
- CVE-2025-1101: Patch notes attached (cve-2025-1101-patch-notes.txt) — the runtime fix is available in release v2.3.1 and will be rolled to Dedicated pools under the next maintenance window; we have scheduled a hotpatch for any impacted Dedicated tenants within 24 hours of acceptance for customers with emergency maintenance enabled.

Next steps:
1) We will send a DocuSign link for the attestation letter by EOD today.
2) If you need unredacted logs for audit, we will coordinate an NDA / secure transfer and a limited-time access window.
3) If you want a 30-minute technical walkthrough of the playbook and patch procedure, propose a slot and we will confirm.

If anything in the attestation requires modification to match your contract language, flag it and we will update before DocuSign.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
